key_phrases: Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 31%
demand that exceeds our supply by a bit
capital expenditures to increase materially on a sequential basis
orchestrating a new era of AI transformation
AI services contributed 7 points of growth
analysis.reasoning: The quarter was exceptionally strong with record revenues and double-digit growth across key segments, particularly Azure (+31%) and Microsoft Cloud. Management demonstrated extremely high confidence, specifically addressing the massive CapEx speculation by framing it as a demand-driven necessity to maintain leadership in AI training and inference. While there is a notable mention of capacity constraints (supply not meeting demand) and FX headwinds, the overall tone remains highly optimistic due to the 'explosive' nature of AI-driven demand and the successful integration of Activision Blizzard. The transcript was highly quantitative, providing specific growth percentages and user counts for almost every product line.
